payload.title: 366 font-mono usages in about 170 web files (sensor-module 61, aquamobil 51, admin-panel 21, farm-module 13) still set readings and figures in Geist Mono, while the owner decision keeps the mono face for code and IDs only
evidence: web/apps/aquamobil/src (51 files use font-mono; tailwind.config.js fontFamily.mono)
payload.rule_violated: Owner decision 2026-10-26 (Okan): Geist Mono only for code and IDs; text and figures are Inter with tabular-nums.
payload.notes: Needs a per-usage classification (identifier or code versus reading or number); ships as UI-0b, the PR after the Inter typography change.
